summary.text: Joe Porambo is the Libertarian candidate for the Wyoming House of Representatives, District 58, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Joe Porambo has run in several Wyoming elections.
He ran for U.S. Senate in 2014 as a Libertarian and received 2.2 percent of the vote, and he appeared as an independent candidate in the 2016 District 58 House general election, receiving 250 votes.
He was the Libertarian candidate in the 2018 U.S. Senate race, receiving 2.8 percent of the vote.
In 2020 he lost the District 58 House general election to incumbent Patrick Sweeney, receiving 19.0 percent of the vote.
In 2022 Ballotpedia listed him among withdrawn or disqualified candidates for the District 58 general election.
